teriġüten: teriġü — head; plural possessive -ten, 'those having heads, the headed ones' (noun + plural possessive; uncertain: the Ming 項每 has 項 'neck' or 'item, kind' (perhaps 頭項 'headman'), so 'chiefs' and 'branches' are both only readings) [項每] · also with the Ming 等項 'and the like', 'X and the other headmen' (項 'item' or 'neck', 等 'and so on') · also with the Ming 等項 'and the rest', after a name: Žamuqa teriġüten, 'Jamuqa and those headed by him' (uncertain) · also 'and the rest' (Ming 等), teriġü 'head, chief' + -ten (uncertain) · also with the Ming 等 'and the rest', teriġü 'head, chief' + plural possessive -ten, 'those headed by him' (uncertain) [等]
öġesün: öġesün — oneself, himself, emphatic (pronoun; Ming 自己) [自己]
baγ̇uba: baγ̇u- — to descend, come down (Ming 下); past -ba, 'came down' (verb, past tense) [下了]
köġüd: köġün — son; plural köġüd, 'sons' (noun + plural -d) [子每] · also 'lords, princes' in the address Taičiγud köġüd (Ming 大王每)
öčižü: öči- — to report, speak to a superior (stem inferred from the Ming 奏); converb -žü, 'reporting' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [奏着]
irerün: ire- — to come; converb -rün, 'coming, while coming' (verb, converb) [來的]
čeriġüd: čerig — soldier; plural -d, 'soldiers' (noun + plural; the vowel is Shiratori's linking -ü-) [軍每]
man-u: man-u — our, of us (ba, genitive stem man- + -u, the possessor stands before or after its noun) [俺的]
kürbe: kür- — to reach, arrive; past -be, 'reached' (verb, past tense) [到了]
üge-ġer: üge — word, speech; instrumental -ġer, 'by words, with words' (noun + instrumental, front-vowel form) [言語裏]
jabuqun: jabu- — to walk, to go about, to travel; participle -qun, 'the one going' (verb, participle; the ending is uncertain, Ming 行的) [行的]
ba: ba — and, both (conjunction) [并] · also 'we', first-person plural pronoun (Ming 俺, against bida 咱), standing at the head of its clause or after the verb · also 'also, even' after a word (Ming 也), as in ger-tür(i)-jen ba ülü odun
ireġesü: ire- — to come; conditional -ġesü, 'when, if (he) came' (verb, conditional; Ming 來了呵) [來了呵] · also with the Ming 來呵 'if (he) comes'
žarliγ: žarliγ — command, decree (Ming 聖旨) (noun) [聖旨]
bolurun: bol- — to become (verb); -urun, converb of time, 'when becoming' (verb, converb; Ming 做的) [做的]
jabudqun: jabu- — to go, travel; -d-, element of unknown force (uncertain); -qun, imperative-optative to several, 'you all, go!' (verb, imperative plural) [行您] · also jabu- 'to go, travel' with -dqun, the plural polite command, 'you (all) go' (the ending whole, as in qairaladqun; Ming 行每您) [行每您]
oroγ̇ulžu: oro- — to enter; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'making enter, bringing in' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form; Ming 敎入着) [敎入着] · also ‘making surrender’ (Ming 敎投降着) [敎投降着]
balaγasun-ača: balaγasun — town, city (noun); ablative -ača, 'from' (noun + case) [(城)子每處]
žusažu: žun — summer; verb-maker -sa-, 'spend (the summer)'; converb -žu, '-ing' (noun-verb, converb) [住夏着]
tolui-dur: Tolui — Tolui, a man's name; dative-locative -dur, 'to Tolui' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名行]
elčin: elčin — envoy, messenger (noun; Ming 使臣) [使臣]
bolba: bol- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了] · also an auxiliary after a participle in -qu, -kü: bariqu bolba, kürgekü bolba, 'came to seize, came to lay on'
busud: busu — other, not so, different; plural -d, 'the others' (adjective/noun + plural; the Ming 不是 is 'not so'; the sense in its context is uncertain) [不是] · also Ming 別的每 'the others' (busu + plural -d)
bidan-dur: bida — we (inclusive); stem extension -n + dative-locative -dur, 'to us' (pronoun + case suffix) [咱行] · also, with the Ming 俺行 (not only 咱行), 'to us'; the Ming alternates 俺 and 咱 for the same inclusive form
ileġesü: ile- — to send (the Ming glosses 去 'go'); conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) sends' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form) [去呵]
tolui: Tolui — Tolui, a man's name (personal name; the token left before -(j)a) [人名 行]
abču: ab- — to take; converb -ču, 'taking' (verb, converb) [要着]
ebdežü: ebde- — to break, destroy; converb -žü, 'breaking' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [破着]
büküi-dür: bü- — to be; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the being, when being' (verb, participle + case; Ming 有時) [有時]
kelen: kelen — word, speech, language (noun) [言語] · also 'word, speech' (Ming 話)
kürgeġesü: kürge- — to bring to, deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) brings to' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form) [送到呵]
qarin: qarin — back, again (adverb; Ming 回) [囘] · also 'tribe, division' (Ming 部 'division, section'; sense uncertain), in harban γurban qarin, 'thirteen divisions' · also read as qari- 'to return' + converb -n, 'returning' (Ming 囘)
ireġed: ire- — to come; converb -ġed, 'having come' (verb, converb, perfective) [來了]
neilebe: neile- — to join, unite (stem inferred from the Ming 相合); past -be, 'joined' (verb, past tense, front-vowel form) [相合了]
